text:
Camille R: Quick status check for Orchid Labs on‑prem rollout — cutover window booked for Thu 2026-06-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need final network signoff, image transfer plan, and KMS/HSM readiness. Owners below.

Camille R: Owners: Ben K (network & LB), Matt L (image transfer / courier), Sara N (KMS + key provisioning), Camille R (cutover coordinator).

Ben K: Network checklist — I still need netops to confirm allowed ports and MTU for the site. Also need L4 LB config for health checks.

netops-bot: Firewall request #3452 created. Preliminary approvers: netops (Ben K), security. Required ports: 22, 443, 50051 (gRPC), 9200 (metrics) — waiting on confirmation.

Matt L: For air-gapped image transfer we can either rsync over a secured transit link or ship an encrypted SSD. Courier ETA options: Wed evening or Thu morning. Which do we prefer?

Camille R: Prefer Wed evening so team can validate on Thu morning pre-cutover. Matt pls confirm courier and signature chain.

Sara N: KMS notes — staging showed Redwood agent can call out to customer KMS via VPN once keys are provisioned. HSM team needs to generate a key with import/export flags disabled. I have a test key id: orch-kms-test-01. Production key request must be made by customer.

Matt L: I'll schedule the courier for Wed 2026-06-04 18:30 PT. Courier will deliver encrypted SSD. Plan for on-site engineer to attach and run this command to seed images:

```bash
# run on orchid-onprem-host as root
mount /dev/sdb1 /mnt/seed
rsync -av --progress /mnt/seed/images/ /opt/redwood/images/
systemctl restart redwood-inference
```

Ben K: MTU note — last site had jumbo frames on the storage network (MTU 9000) which caused fragmentation across our tunnel. Recommend forcing MTU 1500 on the VPN tunnel endpoints for the rollout. Netops, can we enforce?

netops-bot: Change window conflict detected: scheduled maintenance 2026-06-04 23:00-00:30 UTC in same region. Please advise if cutover prep must avoid this.

Camille R: We must avoid the maintenance overlap. Matt, if courier arrives Wed 18:30 PT we still need network config complete before 23:00 UTC. Ben, any chance to push LB changes earlier?

Ben K: I can bump the LB change to Wed 20:00 UTC but need approval from infra-oncall. Pinging @deploy-bot for an oncall handoff.

deploy-bot: Oncall handoff request sent to infra-oncall. Please include runbook link and rollback plan.

Sara N: KMS/HSM: customer requested HSM maintenance window 2026-06-04 22:00-22:30 UTC for key generation. That's close to netops window. We need to coordinate — otherwise key won't be ready by cutover.

Camille R: Action items (short):
- Ben K: open LB change PR and confirm oncall approval (ENG-4567).
- Matt L: courier + seed instructions, confirm arrival and signature.
- Sara N: confirm final key id and that HSM window is moved or acceptable.
- Netops: confirm ports + MTU enforcement and avoid maintenance overlap.

Ben K: ENG-4567 created: https://redwood.internal/changes/ENG-4567 — PR description includes LB healthcheck config and canary IPs. Assigning to infra-oncall.

Matt L: Courier booked, manifest: courier#8721, ETA Wed 18:28 PT. I'll DM the on-site engineer contact.

Sara N: KMS ask submitted to customer; they can move HSM window to 21:30-22:00 UTC. Waiting on their confirmation.

netops-bot: Firewall request #3452 updated: approvers cleared. MTU enforcement policy applied to vpn-orchid-1: MTU=1500.

Camille R: Nice — that's progress. Final quick asks: Ben please confirm canary IPs are allowed by customer firewall; Matt verify checksum of SSD images and post sha256 here once seeded; Sara confirm production key id when available.

Ben K: Canary IPs: 34.82.12.10/32 and 34.82.12.11/32 — I sent these to orchid-netops, they acked.

Matt L: Will post checksum after seeding. Example check: `sha256sum redwood-image-20260605.tar.gz`

Sara N: Prod key id (tentative): orch-kms-01 — awaiting HSM confirmation for final provisioning.

Camille R: OK — I'll compile this into the runbook and schedule a 30-min async sync tomorrow 2026-06-03 15:00 UTC. Please react with :thumbsup: when you see this and call out any remaining blockers.

Ben K: :thumbsup:
Matt L: :thumbsup:
Sara N: :thumbsup:
netops-bot: :white_check_mark:
